author: Cleo Abram
description:
We are trying to go faster than ever before on the moon… 

There was a competition to build the next truck to drive on the lunar surface and this one was one of two winners.

It’s going to launch in 2028 and we got to test out the even more advanced version of this truck. 

To see that, subscribe!

#shorts #moon #space #speed #earth
title: This Truck Is Going To The Moon
